sourceAuthority.existenceRule: A product is considered cataloged if it appears in either the current official products web catalog/detail pages or the currently linked official PDF 'Catálogo Completo 2025'. Semantic similarity alone must never create a product.
sourceAuthority.detailRule: CAS, description, presentations and applications are populated only from current official web detail pages when available. PDF-only products intentionally keep those fields null/empty rather than inventing data.
sourceAuthority.productIdentityRule: Canonical product identity is separate from requested presentation, quantity, container, grade and other modifiers.
